summary.text: Kenny Titus is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 18 (Pottawatomie County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2025.
Kenny Titus is listed as a vice chair of the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the same page, Kenny Titus served in the House (2023–2024) before the current service in the Senate that began in 2025.
Kenny Titus is listed as a member of the Judiciary Committee, the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee, the Commerce Committee and the Local Government, Transparency and Ethics Committee.
The Legislature lists Kenny Titus's occupation as Attorney.
The page names Kara Titus as Kenny Titus's spouse.
